description: Volkswagen and TU Braunschweig research team provides globally referenced high-definition road maps annotated in dense LiDAR point clouds from Hamburg. The source gives 127 km of road sections, 467 km of individual lanes and 266,762 mapped items. Annotations include traffic signs and lights, poles, road markings, ordinary and temporary lanes, construction sites and selected object relationships. The package has training, validation and test location definitions, 648 point-cloud tiles and recorded vehicle trajectories. Fifteen recorded trajectories are supplied, while the paper counts fourteen because two substantially overlap; neither number means independent trials. JSON annotations and binary point clouds support the associated 3DHDNet map-element and map-deviation detection pipeline. Source dates do not establish current road conditions. The related DevKit is a software component, with different rights from the dataset. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
